image_description: A low-angle, close-up shot of a large radio telescope dish against a clear blue sky. The image focuses on the upper rim and the complex white lattice support structure (truss work) beneath the dish. A receiver cabin or feed horn assembly is visible mounted on top of the dish rim. The structure appears to be made of painted steel.
